verdict.rationale: Highnote is a SaaS payments platform that handles customer data, so a policy or control preventing that data from training AI models is a fair question, and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers card issuance, spend controls, PCI SDKs and dashboard permissions, but nothing addresses AI-training opt-outs or data-use policies. Role-based permissions and PCI iframes are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
